sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS difference FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Student_Club';
